summary: Tested the Overview 'Your numbers' tabs, the Landline to Texting section on My numbers, and the Landline-to-Texting setup-step emails. Everything requested passed. Overview (Alice): the Calling 8 / Mobile 4 / Texting 6 tabs show counts and switch the panel. Each tab shows at most 5 rows, with '+3 more' (to /app/numbers) and '+1 more' (to /app/texting). Texting rows link to /app/texting?id=<id>, and opening GAPCHK-2 from the Overview selects that number. Mobile rows go to /app/numbers and calling rows to /app/numbers/<enc phone>. The low-balance warning shows the earliest future renewal (GAPCHK-1, Nov 13, $50). The past-dated +19995550001 (Nov 8) was correctly left out. My numbers: the texting-lines section sits below the calling cards and mobile-lines. It shows 6 cards with the right number, status and bill text: 'Next bill Nov 13, 2026 · $50.00/month' (standalone active), 'Included with your plan on +13346972125 · no monthly fee' (plan-attached), and 'Billing starts once texting is on' (verify step). The cancelled GAPCHK-3 is not shown, and the cards open /app/texting?id=<id>. A texting-only TEST_ account sees the section and no empty state; a fresh TEST_ account with no numbers sees 'No numbers yet'. Emails: check_texting_step_emails.js matched every expectation. On the live server, GAPCHK-2 got a 'review' email and then an 'active' email when the dry-run moved it on; the cancelled GAPCHK-3 got none. textingStep renders in en/fr/es for all 7 steps, with the link, the refund and the note.

ui_bugs.issue: The plan number in 'Included with your plan on <planNumber>' skips pv.phone(), so privacy mode still shows it in full while the line's own number is masked.

issues: The subtitle reads 'Your number · Landline to Texting'. 'Your number' stands in for a country and reads oddly. Plan-attached rows show no billing hint, unlike My numbers ('Included with your plan').

action_items: Optional: wrap the planNumber in TextingLines billText with pv.phone() for privacy mode.
Optional: on the Overview texting rows, show 'included with plan' for plan-attached numbers and use a clearer label than 'Your number'.
critical_code_review_comments: emails.textingSteps marks emailedStatus before sending. If send() throws (e.g. an SMTP error in live mode), that step's email is lost for good. Acceptable for at-most-once delivery, but worth knowing.
textingSteps runs find() with $expr and no index on hostedSms(status, emailedStatus), every tick. Fine at the current volume.
A number going paused then back to active sends no new email, because emailedStatus stays 'active'. Probably intended.
Numbers.js still treats any mobile item (any status, including cancelled) as 'has numbers' and hides the empty state. This is old code, not part of this change.

Bob (civr.bob@example.com) is not a 'no numbers' account any more: he has 3 calling numbers and 7 texting setups left by earlier test runs. Update test_credentials.md; I used a fresh TEST_ account for the empty state instead.

success_rate.backend: 100% (the depositNudge render failure in test_cloudivr_emails_2026-10.js is old and already known)

seed_data_creation: I created 2 TEST_ accounts (ids 5000000000000069 and 5000000000000070) and one hostedSms doc (TESTONLY-5000000000000069), then deleted all three by id. Other records the sign-ups may have created were not removed. Ran `node scripts/seed_texting_gap_check.js clean` at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: In preview the dry-run moves hostedSms from review to active within about a minute, so GAPCHK-2 shows as active a little after seeding. Email log collection: webEmailLog, keys texting:<id>:<status>:<ts>. On webAccounts, _id is numeric while hostedSms.chatId is a string. Don't rely on Bob having no numbers.
